svg.text: Guardrailed Agentic MLOps - Classical Pipeline Architecture
Offline evaluation on RTS-GMLC. No quantum, GNN, or LLM component. Agents advisory; governance decides.

g.text: Checksummed manifests (SHA-256 per source file) - census-sampled hourly series (8,784 h/target, 2020) - lag + calendar features, train-only scaling
Frozen finalists: Random forest / MLP / Hist gradient boosting (B_lags_only) - published day-ahead + persistence as external benchmarks
Historical replay, weekly windows - PSI, normalized Wasserstein, rolling MAE - frozen P99 thresholds - severity NONE/WATCH/WARNING/CRITICAL
Deterministic rule-based agents - 5 advisory types allowed - 7 lifecycle actions blocked and audited - memory: structured summaries + evidence refs
Phase 13 policy: 13-state lifecycle, 12 ordered gates, 16 reason codes - ALLOW / DENY / REQUIRE_APPROVAL with SHA-256 fingerprints
Mandatory verified rollback before promotion takes effect - append-only JSONL audit ledger
Locked final-test window: 2020-11-01 to 2020-12-31 (1,464 h), sealed by the Phase 19 protocol freeze
Honest results: PV beats persistence (-7.6%); load (+72.3%) and wind (+135.1%) lose to day-ahead; 7/7 candidates DENIED by governance.
